reporting-org.narrative: ORRAAs mission is to build the resilience of 250 million climate vulnerable coastal people by 2030, by deploying at least USD$500 million of investment into coastal and ocean resilience through the development of at least 50 novel finance and insurance products.

title.narrative: United Nations Development Programme - Improving resilience of coral reefs and dependent communities

description.narrative: This project focuses on creating sustainable risk management solutions by using insurance to protect natural coastal assets that generate revenue and offer defense against natural weather events. It will develop and implement a coral reef insurance program in Indonesia, significantly reducing the vulnerability of low-income coastal communities to climate-related disasters.

recipient-country.narrative: This project will benefit communities in Indonesia.

sector.narrative: The objective of the project is to implement sustainable risk management solutions by utilizing insurance to safeguard natural assets, which generate social and economic externalities, and offer protection against extreme weather events.
